method: One setting varied at a time from the starting settings; a value is adopted only if it lowers the mean cost by more than the margin with no added falls; the combined choice is then checked against the start.

ablation.label: Contact-aware controller, settings at the start of the sweep
No balancing lean from the sensed slope
Shaft angle held to its flat-floor bookkeeping
Rim contact read like the spherical surface
Normal read from the solver, not force and moment
Gains scheduled against the sensed ground
Reference applied to the contact point
Heading held with the idle shell
